title: Ultralight Custom Steel: How Scarab Built a 15-Pound Climbing Bike
content:
Forget what you know about heavy steel frames. Featuring a proprietary ultralight Columbus tubeset, 3D-printed dropouts, and a Campagnolo Super Record 13 build, Scarab's latest release pushes metal straight into the modern superbike weight class.

Read the full article at Ultralight Custom Steel: How Scarab Built a 15-Pound Climbing Bike on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
